metadata.name: Bell Thirty
metadata.author: Pedaleira
metadata.summary: A chiming clean amp: a 12AX7 input stage, the volume pot, a second 12AX7 stage, a fixed voicing network (a treble, middle and bass network at fixed settings, standing for the channel's coupling and voicing parts) and a push-pull pair of EL84 with no global feedback, whose drive is shunted by a tone cut control. A typical topology of the kind, not the schematic of one product; its values were fitted to measurements of a reference amp (its VOLUME sweep, its response with every knob at 5 and its tone cut sweep). Every value the fit moved is marked "fitted" with what it was fitted to.
references: D. T. Yeh and J. O. Smith, the closed-form analysis of the treble, middle and bass tone stack, DAFx-06, 2006
J. Pakarinen and D. T. Yeh, A review of digital techniques for modeling vacuum-tube guitar amplifiers, Computer Music Journal 33(2), 2009

Pedaleira measurements of a reference amp played through a modelling unit's USB input: GAIN sweeps with a 1 kHz staircase, THD at the staircase's -18 dBFS step, the test signal's sweeps and the tone knob sweeps (2026), with the signal 24 dB under its nominal level
